arxiv-2004-03289.title: KorNLI and KorSTS: New Benchmark Datasets for Korean Natural Language Understanding
arxiv-2004-03289.creator: Jiyeon Ham, Yo Joong Choe, Kyubyong Park, Ilji Choi, Hyungjoon Soh
arxiv-2004-03289.description: Abstract Natural language inference (NLI) and semantic textual similarity (STS) are key tasks in natural language understanding (NLU). Although several benchmark datasets for those tasks have been released in English and a few other languages, there are no publicly available NLI or STS datasets in the Korean language.

arxiv-2105-07850.title: The Flipped Classroom model for teaching Conditional Random Fields in an NLP course
arxiv-2105-07850.creator: Manex Agirrezabal
arxiv-2105-07850.description: Abstract In this article, we show and discuss our experience in applying the flipped classroom method for teaching Conditional Random Fields in a Natural Language Processing course. We present the activities that we developed together with their relationship to a cognitive complexity model (Bloom’s taxonomy). After this, we provide our own reflections and expectations of the model itself.

arxiv-2106-05389.title: The Unusual Weak-Line Quasar PG1407+265 and its Foreground z ∼ 0.7 z\sim 0.7 X-ray Cluster Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2106-05389.creator: Jonathan C. McDowell, Aneta Siemiginowska, Matthew Ashby, Katherine Blundell, Luigi C. Gallo
arxiv-2106-05389.description: Abstract We present new observations of the odd z = 0.96 z=0.96 weak-line quasar PG1407+265, and report the discovery of CXOU J140927.9+261813, a z = 0.68 z=0.68 X-ray cluster. Archival X-ray photometry spanning nearly four decades reveals that PG1407+265 is variable at the 1 dex level on a timescale of years.

arxiv-2307-01074.title: Spectral convergence of the Dirac operator on typical hyperbolic surfaces of high genus
arxiv-2307-01074.creator: Laura Monk 1 and Rareş Stan 2
arxiv-2307-01074.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Laura Monk 1 and Rareş Stan 2. In this article, we study the Dirac spectrum of typical hyperbolic surfaces of finite area, equipped with a nontrivial spin structure (so that the Dirac spectrum is discrete). For random Weil–Petersson surfaces of large genus g g with o ⁡ ( g ) o(\sqrt{g}) cusps, we prove convergence of the spectral density to the spectral density of the hyperbolic plane, with quantitative error estimates.

arxiv-2311-04047.title: Extracting human interpretable structure-property relationships in chemistry using XAI and large language models
arxiv-2311-04047.creator: Geemi P. Wellawatte, Philippe Schwaller
arxiv-2311-04047.description: Abstract Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) is an emerging field in AI that aims to address the opaque nature of machine learning models. Furthermore, it has been shown that XAI can be used to extract input-output relationships, making them a useful tool in chemistry to understand structure-property relationships.

arxiv-2412-04007.title: Radial Oscillations in Hybrid Stars with Slow Quark Phase Transition
arxiv-2412-04007.creator: Ilídio Lopes
arxiv-2412-04007.description: Abstract This study investigates the radial oscillations of hybrid neutron stars, characterized by a composition of hadronic external layers and a quark matter core. Utilizing a density-dependent relativistic mean-field model that incorporates hyperons and baryons for describing hadronic matter, and a density-dependent quark model for quark matter, we analyze the ten lowest eigenfrequencies and their corresponding oscillation functions.

arxiv-2502-08687.title: Data Augmentation to Improve Large Language Models in Food Hazard and Product Detection
arxiv-2502-08687.creator: Areeg Fahad Rasheed, M. Zarkoosh, Shimam Amer Chasib, Safa F. Abbas
arxiv-2502-08687.description: Abstract The primary objective of this study is to demonstrate the impact of data augmentation using ChatGPT-4o-mini on food hazard and product analysis. The augmented data is generated using ChatGPT-4o-mini and subsequently used to train two large language models: RoBERTa-base and Flan-T5-base. The models are evaluated on test sets.

arxiv-2505-23845.title: Read Your Own Mind: Reasoning Helps Surface Self-Confidence Signals in LLMs
arxiv-2505-23845.creator: Jakub Podolak, Rajeev Verma
arxiv-2505-23845.description: Abstract We study the source of uncertainty in DeepSeek R1-32B by analyzing its self-reported verbal confidence on question answering (QA) tasks. In the default answer-then-confidence setting, the model is regularly over-confident, whereas semantic entropy—obtained by sampling many responses—remains reliable. We hypothesize that this is because of semantic entropy’s larger test-time compute, which lets us explore the model’s predictive distribution.

arxiv-2510-27216.title: Topological and Metric Pressure for Singular Flows
arxiv-2510-27216.creator: Meijie Zhao, Xiao Wen
arxiv-2510-27216.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce the notions of rescaled metric pressure and rescaled topological pressure for flows by considering three types of rescaled Bowen balls, which take the flow velocity and time reparametrization into account. This approach effectively eliminates the influence of singularities.

arxiv-2511-03620.title: CLAX: Fast and Flexible Neural Click Models in JAX Conference: arXiv preprint; ; CCS: Information systems Learning to rank
arxiv-2511-03620.creator: Philipp Hager, Onno Zoeter, Maarten de Rijke
arxiv-2511-03620.description: Abstract . CLAX is a JAX-based library that implements classic click models using modern gradient-based optimization. While neural click models have emerged over the past decade, complex click models based on probabilistic graphical models (PGMs) have not systematically adopted gradient-based optimization, preventing practitioners from leveraging modern deep learning frameworks while preserving the interpretability of classic models.

pmc-10628107.title: Acute soft head syndrome in a teenager with sickle cell anemia: A case report
pmc-10628107.creator: Ng'weina F Magitta, Francisca B Komanya, Baraka O Alphonce, Mbelwa D Bitesigilwe, Emmanuel M Sindato, John R Meda
pmc-10628107.description: Key Clinical MessageSickle cell disease (SCD) rarely presents with acute soft head syndrome (ASHS) often posing a diagnostic dilemma. Recovery is typically spontaneous, however, in the context of lack of awareness and limited brain imaging it could potentially lead to poor outcome.AbstractASHS is a rare complication of SCD, invariably occurring near puberty with hitherto elusive pathogenic mechanisms.

pmc-10672360.description: Asymmetry plays a major role in biology at all scales. This can be seen in the helix of DNA, the fact that the human heart is on the left side, or that most people use their right hand. A single protein such as Myosin 1D can induce helical motion in another molecule.

pmc-10715931.creator: Larissa Xavier Alves de Oliveira, Débora Rodrigues, João Batista Masson, Verena Nunes e Silva, Maurício Lopes Prudente, Fernando Henrique Fernandes, Fernando Araújo Cintra Canedo, Henrique Lima Guimarães, Giulliano Gardenghi

pmc-11435421.title: HER-2 Receptor and αvβ3 Integrin Dual-Ligand Surface-Functionalized Liposome for Metastatic Breast Cancer Therapy
pmc-11435421.creator: Dilip Kumar Arya, Hemali Deshpande, Ashish Kumar, Kumarappan Chidambaram, Prashant Pandey, Shabnam Anjum, Payal Deepak, Vikas Kumar, Santosh Kumar, Giriraj Pandey, Saurabh Srivastava, Paruvathanahalli Siddalingam Rajinikanth, Nejat Düzgüneş, Udo Bakowsky
pmc-11435421.description: Human epidermal growth factor receptor-2 (HER2)-positive breast cancer metastasis remains the primary cause of mortality among women globally. Targeted therapies have revolutionized treatment efficacy, with Trastuzumab (Trast), a monoclonal antibody, targeting HER2-positive advanced breast cancer. The tumor-homing peptide iRGD enhances the intratumoral accumulation and penetration of therapeutic agents. Liposomes serve as versatile nanocarriers for both hydrophilic and hydrophobic drugs.

pmc-12471989.title: Therapeutic and Nutraceutical Potential of Sargassum Species: A Narrative Review
pmc-12471989.creator: Alejandra Torres-Narváez, Andrea Margarita Olvera-Ramírez, Karen Castaño-Sánchez, Jorge Luis Chávez-Servín, Tércia Cesária Reis de Souza, Neil Ross McEwan, Roberto Augusto Ferriz-Martínez, Carlos Cardoso, Cláudia Afonso, Leonel Pereira
pmc-12471989.description: In the face of agricultural and environmental crises, the ocean and its diverse abundance of species have garnered attention as sources of beneficial compounds for humans, offering sustainable solutions across various sectors with minimal environmental impact. Sargassum, a genus of macroalgae, has long been used in alternative medicine and culinary applications.

pmc-12613547.title: A review on health system-based surveillance for acute flaccid paralysis: technological advancements, challenges, and outlooks
pmc-12613547.creator: Honey Gemechu, Gelane Biru, Eyerusalem Gebremeskel, Hundessa Daba Nemomssa, Kokeb Dese, Efrem Wakjira, Gashaw Demlew, Dessalew Yohannes, Ketema Lemma Abdi, Hamdia Murad, Elbetel Taye Zewde, Bontu Habtamu, Mesfin Tefera, Mikias Alayu, Netsanet Workneh Gidi, Filimona Bisrat, Tenager Tadesse, Legesse K
pmc-12613547.description: BackgroundPoliomyelitis is a severe viral infection that can lead to permanent paralysis or death, primarily affecting children under 15 years of age. Acute Flaccid Paralysis (AFP) surveillance is essential for global polio eradication efforts, enabling the rapid detection, reporting, and investigation of suspected cases.

pmc-12639491.title: Emerging Nonthermal Technologies for the Production of Postbiotics
pmc-12639491.creator: Rohit Thirumdas, Priti Mudgil
pmc-12639491.description: Postbiotics, defined as nonliving microbial cells and their components that confer health benefits to the host, represent a significant advancement in functional foods and dietary supplements. Compared to probiotics and prebiotics, postbiotics offer advantages in product stability, safety, and formulation flexibility. In general practice, heat killing is a widely used method to produce postbiotics.

pmc-13070459.title: Pulmonary cystic destruction in systemic sclerosis and antisynthetase syndrome associated non-specific interstitial pneumonitis: a case series of a novel radiological phenotype
pmc-13070459.creator: Matthew Wells, Giles Dixon, Nidhi Bhatt, Jo Hardy, Huzaifa I Adamali, Harsha Gunawardena, John D Pauling, Shaney L Barratt, Anthony Edey
pmc-13070459.description: ObjectivesTo describe a novel radiographic phenotype of systemic autoimmune rheumatic disease–associated interstitial lung disease (SARD-ILD) observed within a regional specialist multidisciplinary (MDT) service.MethodsThis was a retrospective case series of patients with SARD-ILD complicated by radiographic pulmonary cystic destruction. Cases were identified through review of MDT records from the North Bristol SARD-ILD service.

pmc-13102026.title: Association between sex hormones and innate cytotoxic capacity of circulating and rectal mucosal immune cells
pmc-13102026.creator: Sarah Jung, Mengyu He, Phillip M Murray, Levi Daitch, Chang Su, Colleen F Kelley, S Abigail Smith
pmc-13102026.description: Sex hormones contribute to sexually dimorphic immunological outcomes, including the innate cytotoxic capacity of Natural Killer (NK) cells in populations of cisgender individuals, but has yet to be evaluated in transgender individuals. Here, we quantified innate cytotoxic capacity of circulating PBMC using a K-562-GFP killing assay within a sex and gender inclusive cohort.

pmc-13231836.title: Development and in vivo evaluation of 18F-labeled PET tracers covalently targeting KRAS-G12C for noninvasive cancer diagnosis and therapy monitoring
pmc-13231836.creator: Michael Willmann, Jens P. Bankstahl, Frank M. Bengel, Christine Drechsler, Christina Esdar, Kathrin Gläser, Andrea U. Lopez, Tatjana Ross, Hanno Schieferstein, Tobias L. Ross
pmc-13231836.description: Rationale: Mutations in the KRAS gene are some of the most frequent drivers in cancer, including non-small cell lung and colorectal cancer. Covalent inhibitors such as adagrasib, targeting the inactive, GDP-bound form of KRAS-G12C, have shown clinical efficacy but patient selection still depends on invasive biopsies.

pmc-13270538.title: Ligand-amplified quantum tunneling in polymer-mediated artificial photosystems
pmc-13270538.creator: Peng Su, Si-Han Lin, Fang-Xing Xiao
pmc-13270538.description: Quantum tunneling offers a fascinating paradigm for orchestrating spatial charge transport in artificial photosynthesis. However, precisely manipulating electron tunneling across well-defined heterointerfaces remains a formidable challenge, with conventional designs largely confined to classical Semiconductor–Insulator–Metal (S–I–M) architectures. Herein, we report a conceptual endeavor by fundamentally departing from the traditional S–I–M model, constructing a unique and novel semiconductor–insulator–ligand/metal tunneling platform.
